text: That afternoon: Holmes and Watson come to Stoke Moran as promised
why: Holmes promised to come early in the afternoon (¶82), and at ¶125 he greets Miss Stoner with 'Good-afternoon' and says they have been as good as their word.

text: That day: Holmes and Watson climb the stile, and Holmes explains what he wanted the driver to think
why: ¶125 states they climbed the stile as Holmes explained he wanted the driver to think they had come as architects or on definite business; the trip happens the same day as the morning visit.
